quests.title: Make the Mud Keep Them
quests.text: A road is for marching, and I will not have the dead setting our pace. Break five Mire-Cured Husks by day in the {name:front_broken_causeway/floodmeadows}, which lie {zone_area:front_broken_causeway/floodmeadows}. The Accord can count footprints; give the Throng something worth counting.

quests.title: No Marching After Death
quests.text: Hear that sloshing after sundown? Fordwater Zombies are climbing through the {name:front_broken_causeway/reedmire}, which lies {zone_area:front_broken_causeway/reedmire}, and every patrol has to fight for dry footing. Kill five there at night; I want boots coming home with soldiers still in them.

quests.title: Teeth in the Dark
quests.text: Our scouts keep hearing paws where they ought to hear their own footsteps. Hunt down five Fenrunner Wolves at night in the {name:front_broken_causeway/wraithwood}, which lies {zone_area:front_broken_causeway/wraithwood}. Save the boasting for when you can see what is listening.

quests.title: Payment in Full
quests.text: Toll-Taker Senn wants coin for every Throng boot that crosses his road. Find him at the {name:front_broken_causeway/toll_camp} {dir_from_giver:front_broken_causeway/toll_camp}, kill four Aqueduct Bowmen there, and kill Senn. He can bill me for the trouble.

quests.title: A Name Worth Sending
quests.text: You have put enough dents in the Causeway for me to send your name ahead. Speak with Orrel Hollowstep at Hollowarch Station in Blackwind Rise and tell him Drek Rampbinder sent you. He'll find work for hands like yours, even if he complains about the fingerprints.

quests.title: Bounty: Bad Career Choices
quests.text: Another lot of Causeway Brigands thinks robbing the Throng will pay. Kill five by day in the {name:front_broken_causeway/wraithwood}, which lies {zone_area:front_broken_causeway/wraithwood}, and come back for your reward. You can take this bounty again twenty minutes after turning it in; apparently word travels slower than greed.

quests.title: Nobody Laughs at Supper
quests.text: Warpack Hyenas have found our supply trail, and now the laughing starts before supper. Kill five by day in the {name:front_shattered_line/approaches}, which lie {zone_area:front_shattered_line/approaches}. I can mend a torn ration sack; I cannot sew the meat back into it.

quests.title: Mind the Boots
quests.text: I patch enough holes in our soldiers without War-Stinger Scorpions punching fresh ones through their boots. Kill five after dark on the {name:front_shattered_line/bluffs}, which lie {zone_area:front_shattered_line/bluffs}, and give the next patrol a fighting chance to march home.

quests.title: A Standard with Claws
quests.text: This banner has survived arrows, rain, and a cook who mistook it for a towel. It deserves teeth of its own: kill four Tallgrass Tigers by day on the {name:front_shattered_line/bluffs}, which lie {zone_area:front_shattered_line/bluffs}, and bring me two Siege Cat Claws. Let's give the Accord something new to stare at.

quests.title: Stings for Our Side
quests.text: The archers want venom, and for once their request comes with its own legs. War-Stinger Scorpions crawl at night over the {name:front_shattered_line/ramparts}, which lie {zone_area:front_shattered_line/ramparts}; kill five and bring me two Scorch Venom. Try to keep the stings out of our side of the war.

quests.title: Let That Banner Fall
quests.text: Standard-Bearer Ninepins waves that rag of his over the {name:front_shattered_line/breach} {dir_from_giver:standard_bearer_ninepins}, and the dead still salute. Destroy four Siege Skeleton Raiders there at night and kill Ninepins. I have spent my life keeping standards upright; I'll enjoy hearing about this one falling.

quests.title: Group: Break the War Machine
quests.text: War Construct Engine Nine is still grinding through the {name:front_shattered_line/siegecrest} {dir_from_giver:siege_engine_nine}, as if the war were a nail that needs more hammering. Gather a group and destroy it; one fighter will only add to the dents. I want all of you back to boast about this.

quests.title: Send a Fighter, Save a Banner
quests.text: I could send Kezamba a banner listing what you have done, but I am running short of cloth. Go speak with Nalo Pathdrum in Kezamba; he sends fighters into The Skyglass Canopy. Tell him Yarra Standardmender vouches for you, and mind that you keep earning it.

quests.title: Bounty: Stripes at the Front
quests.text: Tallgrass Tigers care very little whose colours a soldier wears, which makes them a nuisance to everybody. Kill five by day on the {name:front_shattered_line/siegecrest}, which lies {zone_area:front_shattered_line/siegecrest}, and collect your reward from me. The bounty is available again twenty minutes after turn-in.

quests.title: Report to {name:pvp_fortress_throng}
quests.text: The Throng has raised {name:pvp_fortress_throng} {dir_from_giver:pvp_fortress_throng} to carry the war to the Accord camps on the Battlegrounds. Its Warmaster wants every fighter who has already seen the front. Go there and report; the Warmaster will put you to work.
quests.lesson: Entry: from a 31-40 outpost to the PvP fortress at level 40.

quests.title: Steel for the Quartermaster
quests.text: A fortress eats steel faster than bread. The Quartermaster is short of Silversteel Bars for arrowheads and gate bolts. Bring me four, and the walls will thank you before the Accord does.
quests.lesson: Fortress supplies: an ordinary tier-4 bar.

quests.title: Trophies for the Drill Yard
quests.text: Recruits drill harder when they can see what the enemy wore. Bring me six War Trophies taken from Accord guards; any Accord garrison will do. I will hang them where the new blades can count them.
quests.lesson: War Trophies drop only from enemy guards killed by a player (never a player kill).

quests.title: A Clear Road for the Scouts
quests.text: My riders cannot watch the Accord camps while Causeway Brigands prowl the road there. Kill five of them by day in the {name:front_broken_causeway/alderwood}, which lies {zone_area:front_broken_causeway/alderwood}. Then my scouts can ride past and count the enemy's tents.
quests.lesson: Scouting a Battlegrounds zone: a kill quest on its 41-43 kind.

quests.title: Group: Pull Up the {name:pvp_camp_shattered_line_accord_low}
quests.text: The Accord has staked a picket on the Battlegrounds: the {name:pvp_camp_shattered_line_accord_low}, which lies {zone_area:pvp_camp_shattered_line_accord_low}. Gather a group, kill four Accord Guards there and the Accord Captain who holds it. My riders need those eyes put out.
quests.lesson: PvP camp raid: the enemy picket's garrison (area-limited; no player kills).

quests.lesson: PvP camp raid: the enemy picket's garrison (area-limited; no player kills).

quests.title: Group: Burn the {name:pvp_camp_shattered_line_accord_high}
quests.text: The {name:pvp_camp_shattered_line_accord_high}, which lies {zone_area:pvp_camp_shattered_line_accord_high}, is the strongest Accord war camp on the Battlegrounds there. Take a group, kill five Accord Guards and the Accord Captain who commands them. A war camp without a captain is just a lot of tents.
quests.lesson: PvP camp raid: the enemy war camp's garrison (area-limited; no player kills).
